stock.description: Cabbeen Fashion Limited, headquartered in Guangzhou, China, is a diversified enterprise with a core focus on fashion and casual wear. The company designs, sources, and distributes apparel, footwear, and accessories. While historically rooted in menswear, its product lines now cater to men, women, and children, marketed across the People's Republic of China under various brands: Cabbeen, Cabbeen Lifestyle, Cabbeen Urban, Cabbeen Love, and 2AM. Its business operations are segmented into two primary areas: Apparel and Accessories, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), with the latter encompassing both manufacturing and sales. As of December 31, 2021, Cabbeen commanded a substantial retail footprint. In Mainland China, its products were available in 830 retail locations, supported by a network of 6 wholesale, 21 consignment, and 106 sub-distributors. The company also directly operated one retail shop in Hong Kong and managed various franchised stores. Digitally, Cabbeen maintains an active online presence through its own WeChat store, prominent e-commerce platforms such as T-mall, JD.com, and Vipshop, and partnerships with other online distributors. Beyond its fashion and PPE ventures, the company also engages in real estate development, property investment, and intellectual property management.
